# Luxe Event Co.

> Luxe Event Co. is a Toronto event company bringing together staffed mobile coffee, live dessert, and event rentals across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area.

The official website is https://luxeeventco.ca. Visitors can begin with one division, combine complementary experiences, explore by event type, or start an event inquiry.

## Experiences

- [Luxe Coffee Bar](https://luxeeventco.ca/experiences/coffee-bar): Mobile coffee bar, espresso, matcha, seasonal beverage, and custom-branded drink experiences.
- [Luxe Sweet Cart](https://luxeeventco.ca/experiences/sweet-cart): Dessert options include Mini Dutch Pancakes, Belgian Waffles on a Stick, Mini Donuts and the newest signature Luxe Churro Bar. Your selected option or combination of options is confirmed in your proposal. Soft Serve Add-On is available with select dessert options as an optional enhancement and is not offered as a standalone service.
- [Luxe Seating Rentals](https://luxeeventco.ca/experiences/seating-rentals): White resin chairs, 6-ft rectangular tables, cocktail tables, tents, linens and tent walls. Tent Lighting is available with Luxe tent rentals and is not offered as a standalone service. Dance-floor configurations available up to 18' × 18'.

## Events

- [Weddings](https://luxeeventco.ca/events/weddings)
- [Corporate Events](https://luxeeventco.ca/events/corporate-events)
- [Brand Activations](https://luxeeventco.ca/events/brand-activations)
- [Private Events](https://luxeeventco.ca/events/private-events)

## Service context

Luxe serves Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, with select destination events available throughout Southern Ontario. Luxe carries $5 million in liability insurance. Luxe Coffee Bar serves intimate gatherings through large-scale events, with service plans tailored to guest count, menu, venue requirements and event flow. Larger-format events can be accommodated through a customized service plan. Multiple service setups are available for select events.
